subject: English
question_text: Complete the passage using suitable connectors. 1  5 =
stimulus: Honesty is a divine virtue. The man (a) ⎯⎯ possesses this quality is the happiest person in the world. To be honest, man should have trust, worthiness (b) ⎯⎯ nobody trusts a liar. (c) ⎯⎯, Allah also helps the honest people. (d) ⎯⎯, children should be taught honesty from the very beginning of life. (e) ⎯⎯, children should be developed among the honest people.
guide_solution: (a) which (b) Although/Though (c) like/including (d) not only (e) but also
